description: Source code for a stub video decoder implementation in the starboard media framework, including methods for initialization, buffer processing, and frame creation.

classes.name: StubVideoDecoder
classes.description: A stub implementation of a video decoder used for testing or placeholder purposes within the starboard media framework.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions for status and error reporting.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of preroll frames, fixed at 1.

methods.name: GetPrerollTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum 64-bit integer value as the preroll timeout.

methods.name: GetMaxNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of cached frames, fixed at 12.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Schedules decoding of input buffers on a separate thread.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of stream, either scheduling end-of-stream processing or directly invoking the callback.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, clears buffers, and cancels pending jobs.

methods.name: DecodeBuffers
methods.description: Processes input buffers, manages frame buffering, and invokes callbacks with decoded frames.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Outputs remaining frames and signals end of stream.

methods.name: CreateOutputFrame
methods.description: Creates a YV12 video frame with specified timestamp.
